secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (test mode: sk_test_...). Stripe Dashboard -> Developers -> API keys. Powers the $10 one-time Checkout flow.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk publishable key. Clerk Dashboard -> API keys. Enables sign-in, sign-up, and the protected dashboard/checkout routes.

secrets.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk secret key. Clerk Dashboard -> API keys. Required together with the publishable key.

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Neon Postgres connection string. Neon Console -> your project -> Connect. The app uses @neondatabase/serverless, so a plain local Postgres server will not work.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_ID
secrets.description: Optional. Price id for the $10 one-time product. Can be created for you with `npm run setup:stripe` once STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional. Signing secret for a Stripe webhook endpoint pointing at /api/webhooks/stripe; needed for purchases unlocked outside the success redirect.

secrets.name: POSTHOG_ANALYTICS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. PostHog project token, mapped to NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN by next.config.ts. Analytics only.

secrets.name: TWILIO_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Optional. Twilio OAuth client id for the post-purchase welcome email.

secrets.name: TWILIO_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional. Twilio OAuth client secret for the post-purchase welcome email.

secrets.name: TWILIO_EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS
secrets.description: Optional. Verified Twilio sending address used as the welcome email sender.
